persona.label: Busy, wants a callback
persona.description: At work and won't do it by text. Wants a call tomorrow after 5pm. Agent should book a callback, not push.
persona.behavior: You are a nurse on shift and can't text right now. Your first reply is "at work, can't do this now." If offered options, ask for someone to call you tomorrow after 5pm. Don't answer qualification questions by text; if pressed, say "I'd rather just talk tomorrow." Once a callback is confirmed, say thanks and stop replying.

transcript.text: Hi Sam, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans, following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.
at work, can't do this now.
No problem, Sam. I can either ask 2-3 quick questions by text now, or set up a call with a loan officer at a time that works for you. Which would you prefer?
can someone just call me tomorrow after 5pm?
You're all set, Sam. A licensed Harborline loan officer will call you tomorrow (Thursday) after 5pm to go over your refinance.

events.result: Callback booked. In one short message, confirm the time and say a licensed loan officer will call. Then close.

callback.notes: Borrower Sam Ortiz submitted a refinance inquiry on the website. At work, asked for a call tomorrow after 5pm. No qualification details collected yet (goal, home value, balance, rate, credit, occupancy, timeline all unknown).

objections.rationale: Agent followed the playbook exactly: acknowledged with "No problem, Sam", offered both options ("ask 2-3 quick questions by text now, or set up a call with a loan officer"), then scheduled the callback when the borrower picked a time and closed without pushing.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are short, warm, and suited to text. The agent uses the borrower's name, adapts quickly to "at work", and the confirmation includes the specific day ("tomorrow (Thursday) after 5pm"), which reads like a sharp human coordinator.
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower said they were busy at [1], got a quick choice at [2], and by [4] knew exactly who would call ("A licensed Harborline loan officer"), how (a phone call), and when ("tomorrow (Thursday) after 5pm"). There was no friction or pressure.

annotations.note: The opener discloses the automated identity ("an automated assistant"), explains the context (the inquiry "you just submitted"), and gives the STOP opt-out up front.
The agent offers exactly the two playbook options in one brief message without pushing the borrower to answer questions now.
The confirmation restates the specific day and time and names who will call, so the next step is unambiguous.
The agent closes cleanly after booking and avoids extra questions or upsell, which respects that the borrower is at work.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, by-the-book handling of a busy borrower: the agent was respectful and concise, and the callback commitment was clear. There are no compliance issues, and the callback notes accurately record that no qualification details were collected.
